Harvard Classics, Vol. 26, Part 5

Minna von Barnhelm Or, The Soldier’s Fortune

Gotthold Ephraim Lessing

Written at the close of the Seven Years’ War, 
Minna von Barnhelm
 is considered to be Lessing’s greatest drama. One of the first German national dramas, it tells the story of Tellheim, a sensitive German soldier, and Minna, his love.
